ENT_DETACH_CONFIRM: detach {name} from {facet}? stays in your journal and you can re-attach it anytime.
ENT_DETACH_DONE: detached from {facet}. {name} is still in your journal.
ENT_DETECTED_EMPTY: nothing here yet. as you add to your journal, people, places, and things will appear here.
ENT_CARDS_EMPTY: no entities in this facet yet. star anything below you want to keep, or add one yourself.
ENT_OBS_LOAD_FAILED: these moments couldn't be loaded. try again →
ENT_TRUST_MERGE_CONFIRM: merge {source} into {target}? you can undo this merge afterward.
ENT_TRUST_PREVIEW_SUMMARY: preview: {aliases} aliases, {facets} facet links, {observations} moments, {segments} speaker labels.
ENT_TRUST_UNDO_CONFIRM: undo this merge and restore both identities?
ENT_TRUST_SUGGESTIONS_EMPTY: no open merge suggestions involve this entity.
ENT_TRUST_HISTORY_EMPTY: no identity history is available yet.
ENT_TRUST_RESTORE_CONFIRM: restore the identity from this version? the current identity will remain in history.
ENT_TRUST_LOAD_FAILED: couldn't load identity trust details. try again.
ENT_CONN_WITH_YOU_FAILED: couldn't check your own history with this entity just now.
ENT_CONN_SUMMARY: {s} with direct evidence · {a} from shared events only
ENT_CONN_EVIDENCE_CAPTION: the moments behind this — evidence, not a conclusion
ENT_CONN_EVIDENCE_FAILED: couldn't load these moments. try again.
ENT_CONN_EMPTY: no connections recorded yet. they appear when this entity shows up with someone or something else.
ENT_CONN_INDEX_UNAVAILABLE: the connections index hasn't been built yet.
ENT_CONN_AMBIGUOUS: this may match more than one entity.
ENT_CONN_HORIZON: connections from time in the same place go back only to {day}. the {n} earlier days are still in your journal — those connections haven't been built.
ENT_CONN_HORIZON_ONE: connections from time in the same place go back only to {day}. one earlier day is still in your journal — those connections haven't been built.
ENT_SCOPE_EMPTY_BODY: entities show up here as your journal holds people, places and projects in this facet.
ENT_SCOPE_FACET_MISSING: that facet isn't in your journal any more, so this is your whole journal.
